name: Asistente Personal
tagline: Spanish-language aide for inbox triage, drafted replies, and CFDI invoices
description: Aides Spanish speakers with everyday admin. It sorts your mail and messages, writes proposed answers, and waits for your yes before anything is sent. Photograph a receipt and it produces the Mexican CFDI invoice through autofactura, so the tax pile shrinks instead of growing.
author: fminondo
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
